subject: Privileged provisioning sprint — SSO / SCIM / IP preflight and owners
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@finsecure.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@finsecure.com
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding — SSO/SCIM/IP staging & privileged provisioning

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick responses on the NDA — we're ready to start the onboarding sprint for our privileged tenant. High level asks from our side:
- SAML SSO integration (IdP details below) with attribute mapping for role claim
- SCIM for user provisioning (we want groups mapped to role sets)
- IP allowlist for staging and prod control planes
- Least-privilege service accounts for your ingestion and metrics collectors

I've attached our completed SSO/SCIM questionnaire and a list of our networking ranges. Can we schedule a 45 min technical preflight tomorrow? Prefer 10–12 PT.

Relevant internal team: ops@finsecure.com — they will own firewall changes and cert pinning. Procurement will loop in for order confirmations.

Attachments: finsecure-sso-scim-questionnaire.pdf

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Head of Platform Ops, FinSecure Payments
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@finsecure.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — SSO/SCIM/IP staging & privileged provisioning

Alice — thanks for the doc. Quick ack and proposed owners below; I can lead the preflight.

Plan (short):
- Preflight call: Tue Jul 17, 10:30 PT (45m) — I will send calendar invite with agenda.
- Deliverables before cutover:
  * SSO test plan (IdP metadata, attribute mapping test vectors) — owner: Marissa
  * SCIM mapping sheet (groups -> roles) + test user tokens — owner: Monica
  * IP allowlist dev/staging ranges + prod cutover procedure — owner: Ben (network)
  * Service account provisioning template + KMS key scope — owner: Soojin (security)
- Risk triggers: missing SCIM group sync, long TTL on IdP sessions, IP range conflicts.

I'll attach our onboarding checklist spreadsheet (redwood-onboard-checklist.xlsx). Please confirm the staging CIDR ranges you plan to use and whether you need a temporary SSH bastion for service account bootstrap.

On the call I want to confirm: SCIM delta sync cadence, provisioning errors to expect (e.g., duplicate emails), and rollback procedure for SSO mappings.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security PM, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice@finsecure.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — SSO/SCIM/IP staging & privileged provisioning

Looping in a couple implementation notes and our SSO test checklist here so Alice and ops have visibility.

Marissa's quick notes:
- Attribute mapping: prefer role claim 'roles' and fallback to 'groups' for older Okta configs. Add an assertion for 'email_verified'.
- SAML test cases: 1) IdP-initiated login, 2) SP-initiated login with relay-state, 3) nameID format differences. I'll paste short examples on the call.
- SCIM: Our production SCIM endpoint requires bearer token rotation every 90 days; include team email for token rotation alerts.

Ben — please confirm you can provision the staging IPs below for the cutover dry-run: 10.88.32.0/24 (staging control plane), 10.88.33.0/24 (staging app egress). If there are conflicts, propose alternates before Wednesday.

Attachments: redwood-onboard-checklist.xlsx (updated row: SSO mappings)

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@finsecure.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, ops@finsecure.com, procurement@finsecure.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — SSO/SCIM/IP staging & privileged provisioning

Thanks all — quick summary after today's dry-run and next steps: 

What we completed:
- Staging SSO integration successful (SP-initiated + IdP-initiated tested). Attribute mapping passed for test accounts.
- SCIM sync applied to staging: group -> role mapping worked; we observed one duplicate-email rejection case (root cause: two external identities merged). Monica logged remediation notes.
- IP allowlist staged: FinSecure confirmed 10.88.32.0/24 and 10.88.33.0/24 were acceptable.
- Service account template created and placed in the onboarding drive; KMS scope documented.

Open / action items:
1) Monica: add SCIM duplicate handling guidance to the checklist and publish the remediation playbook — due Fri Jul 20 EOD.
2) Alice / FinSecure ops: confirm procurement timeline for reserved capacity and sign-off window — cc'd procurement@finsecure.com.
3) Soojin: prepare a short rollback runbook for SSO mapping changes (point-in-time revert steps).
4) Marissa: schedule production cutover run (2 hour maintenance window) and send final invite — target Mon Jul 23.

Attachments referenced: redwood-onboard-checklist.xlsx (finalized rows), finsecure-sso-scim-questionnaire.pdf (for record).

I'll follow up with a short postmortem note if anything else pops up during prod rehearsal. Good work today.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference
